{"consolidated_memory":"## Off-by-one cent issues in billing/invoice_totals.py — multiple root causes

Component: billing/invoice_totals.py (billing side). All incidents occurred in the same corner of this module; context from earlier off-by-one cent work carried over.

All incidents share the same repro (total an invoice with three prorated lines) and the same signal (one cent gap in reconciliation report).

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-08]
- Trigger: empty input list
- Root cause: serialiser dropping unknown fields
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 93 days running
- Fix: switched to strict schema rejecting unknown fields
- PR #3157 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1

### Occasion 2: [2026-02-06]
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Result: 8 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #5451 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2

### Occasion 3: [2026-03-12]
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Result: backlog cleared 64 minutes after the deploy
- Fix: switched deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #9081 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-3

### Occasion 4: [2026-04-01]
- Trigger: after client had already retried once
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Result: flaky test went from 39 failures per 100 runs to zero
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #9570 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-4"}
